research_question: Does a fully completed local I7 failed-session auction become tradeable specifically when the raided market leads an efficient displaced repair but the peer majority does not confirm the proposed reversal?

hypothesis.economic_cause: A session raid can be market-wide repricing or instrument-local liquidity collection. When most peers do not follow the proposed reversal but the raided instrument itself has already reclaimed, displaced, formed the required MSS/FVG and leads the event return, the remaining move is local excess repair rather than broad directional transfer.
hypothesis.local_state_machine: Byte-identical I7 raid, reclaim, MSS/FVG, first executable entry, invalidation, target and costed-R rules on BTCUSDT, ETHUSDT, SOLUSDT and XRPUSDT.
hypothesis.cross_market_state: FAR only; at least two of three signed peer event returns are non-positive, local signed event move is positive, event rank is in the top half, and existing path-efficiency and standardized-displacement thresholds pass.
hypothesis.trend_invalidation: Reject only when both the local and median market directional trend scores are at or below the unchanged severe-adverse threshold.
hypothesis.candidate_isolation: Ordinary SCDAM, I7 AAC and peer-majority transfer FAR are observed and explicitly rejected before global arbitration.
hypothesis.risk_and_execution: One GlobalCandidateMutex, one NautilusTrader account, exact current-NAV 3% planned-loss sizing, one pending-entry-or-position slot, unchanged fees, slippage budget, stop and target semantics.
hypothesis.forbidden_changes: No alpha threshold relaxation, fitted peer magnitude, score multiplier, route whitelist, symbol-specific parameter, nominal cap, leverage cap or risk scaling.

diagnostic_lineage.purpose: Mechanism and opportunity diagnosis only. A pass authorizes a fresh pre-data holdout; it is not a success claim.

failure_modes: peer-unanimity rejected most completed session FARs
the only untouched unanimous I7 FAR trade lost
ordinary SCDAM supplied the other holdout trades and obscured the session hypothesis

diagnostic_lineage.controlled_change: Invert the session market distinction from unanimous reversal transfer to majority peer nonconfirmation, retain only completed I7 FAR, and remove every other trading module from the candidate set.

selection.method: Controlled diagnostic reuse of eight already-opened intervals selected before this RFAR hypothesis. No interval is eligible for a success claim or later threshold adjustment.

decision_rule.diagnostic_pass: Every aggregate gate passes without changing the source blobs or any alpha threshold.
decision_rule.on_pass: Freeze fresh non-overlapping intervals before opening their market data, then run the unchanged RFAR variant in NautilusTrader.
decision_rule.on_fail: Reject RFAR. Do not tune peer counts, ranks, efficiency, displacement, trend, session or symbol conditions on D1-D8.
